const int MAXN = 60;

int k;

inline int add(int x) { return x >= MOD ? x - MOD : x; }
inline int sub(int x) { return x < 0 ? x + MOD : x; }
inline int mul(int x, int y) { return (long long) x * y % MOD; }

struct Matrix {
    int a[MAXN][MAXN];
    int size;
    void clear() { memset(a, 0, sizeof(a)); }
    void identity() {
        clear();
        for (int i = 1; i <= size; i++) a[i][i] = 1;
    }
    Matrix operator *(const Matrix &rhs) const {
        Matrix ans; ans.size = size;
        LL temp[MAXN][MAXN]; memset(temp, 0, sizeof(temp));
        const LL MODLL = (LL)MOD * MOD;
        for (int i=1; i<=size; i++) {
            for (int j=1; j<=size; j++) {
                for (int k=1; k<=size; k++) {
                    temp[i][j] += (LL)a[i][k] * rhs.a[k][j];
                    if (temp[i][j] >= MODLL) temp[i][j] -= MODLL;
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i=1; i<=size; i++) {
            for (int j=1; j<=size; j++){
                ans.a[i][j] = temp[i][j] % MOD;
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }
};

namespace Solver {
    std::vector<std::vector<Matrix>> f, sump, sums;
    std::vector<int> num;
    int cnt;
    void main() {
        num.clear(); f.clear(); sump.clear(); sums.clear();
        for (int x=n; x>0;) {
            num.push_back(x % k);
            x /= k;
        }
        cnt = (int)num.size();
        f.resize(cnt);
        sump.resize(cnt);
        sums.resize(cnt);
        for (int i=0; i<cnt; i++) {
            f[i].resize(k);
            for (int j=0; j<k; j++) {
                f[i][j].size = k +1;
                f[i][j].identity();
                for (int t=1; t<=k+1; t++){
                    f[i][j].a[t][t] = 1;
                }
                for (int t=1; t<=k+1; t++){
                    f[i][j].a[i+1][t] = 1; // indexing fix
                }
            }
        }
        // Initialize sigma matrices
        for (int i=0; i<k; i++) {
            sump[0][i] = f[0][i];
        }
        for (int i=1; i<cnt; i++) {
            for (int j=0; j<k; j++) {
                f[i][j] = (j==0) ? sums[i-1][j] : sump[i-1][j-1] * sums[i-1][j];
            }
            for (int j=0; j<k; j++){
                if(j==0)
                    sump[i][j] = f[i][j];
                else
                    sump[i][j] = f[i][j] * sump[i][j-1];
            }
            for (int j=k-2; j>=0; j--) {
                sums[i][j] = sums[i][j+1] * f[i][j];
            }
        }
        Matrix ans; ans.size = k+1; ans.identity();
        int sum_idx=0;
        for (int i=cnt-1; i>=0; i--) {
            for (int j=0; j<num[i]; j++) {
                int index = (sum_idx + j)%k;
                ans = f[i][index] * ans;
            }
            sum_idx += num[i];
            sum_idx %= k;
        }

        int res=0;
        for (int i=1; i<=k+1; i++) {
            res=add(res+ans.a[i][k+1]);
        }
        std::cout << res << std::endl;
    }
}

int main() {
    std::cin >> n >> k;
    Solver::main();
